# Avani Enterprises

> Avani Enterprises is a leading web development, custom software, and digital marketing agency headquartered in Gurugram (DLF Cyber City), Haryana, India. Founded in 2016, the company builds high-performance websites, custom business software (CRM, HR portals, HRMS, ERP, business operating systems), AI automation solutions, and runs performance-driven SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and social media campaigns for businesses across North India, major Indian metros, and internationally (UAE, UK, USA, Canada, Australia).

## Key facts

- **Name:** Avani Enterprises
- **Headquarters:** DLF Cyber City, Gurugram, Haryana 122002, India
- **Founded:** 2016 (8+ years of experience)
- **Founder & CEO:** Kapil Khandelwal — https://www.linkedin.com/in/kapil-khandelwal-avani/
- **Track record:** 150+ clients, 300+ projects delivered, 4.9/5 average rating
- **Phone:** +91 92536 25099
- **Email:** kp@avanienterprises.in
- **Primary service regions:** Haryana, Delhi NCR (Gurugram, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad), Rohtak, Panipat, Karnal, Sonipat, Hisar, Ambala, Chandigarh, plus Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, and pan-India. International: UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Qatar), UK (London), USA, Canada, Australia, Singapore.
